claim: [65ii] is Anyone who thought they could take advantage of us would be disappointed, which “corresponds to the remote conditional If anyone thought they could take advantage of us they would be mistaken.”
evidence_summary: On the same page the open paraphrase of [65i] keeps the predicate: “If anyone thinks they can take advantage of us, they will be disappointed”.
finding: Change mistaken to disappointed. The paraphrase is meant to differ from [65ii] only in form.
proposed_wording: If anyone thought they could take advantage of us they would be disappointed
inference: Does the remote paraphrase keep the predicate of [65ii]?
